english.title: Help asylum seeker to enter United Kingdom - immigration
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly and for gain facilitated the

(A)_[arrival in]_
(B)_[attempted arrival in]_
(C)_[entry into]_
(D)_[attempted entry into]_

the United Kingdom of **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), an individual whom you knew or had reasonable cause to believe was an asylum seeker
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 25A and 25(6) of the Immigration Act 1971.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
knowingly and for gain
facilitated the arrival / attempted arrival in the United Kingdom
of an individual
whom you knew/had reasonable cause for believing
was an asylum seeker

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) On the 28th June 2022, the penalty for offences under this section was increased on indictment from a maximum of 14 years imprisonment to life imprisonment by section 41 of the Nationality and Borders Act 2022. For the offence after this date, see H100720.
(ii) As substituted by section 143 of the Nationality, Immigration and Asylum Act 2002 as from 10/02/03.
(iii) Options (B) and (D), 'attempted arrival / entry', inserted by paragraph 3 of Schedule 14 to the Immigration Act 2016 on 31 May 2016. These options should not be used in relation to incidents occurring prior to this date.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: maximum 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
INDICTMENT: maximum 14 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
The maximum penalty on summary conviction increased from 2nd May 2022, see section 32(1) of the Magistrates’ Courts Act 1980 as amended by section 282(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003. This applies only to offences committed on or after that date, see section 282(4). For offences committed before 2nd May 2022 the maximum penalty on summary conviction is six months.
